# LibreOffice Impress GUI Interface Description

## System and Application Header

- **Operating System Desktop Environment**: Activities panel visible at the top left, indicating a Linux desktop environment.
- **Application Title Bar**: 
  - Application name: "LibreOffice Impress"
  - File name: "campaign_slides.pptx"
  - Date and time: "Oct 22 19:26"
  - System icons: Notification bell icon on the right side of the title bar.
- **Window Controls**: Minimize, maximize, and close buttons on the top right corner.

## Application Menu Bar

- **Menu Options**: File, Edit, View, Insert, Format, Slide, Slide Show, Tools, Window, Help.
- **Application Status**: The application is in edit mode for a presentation file.

## Toolbars

### Main Toolbar (Top)

- **File Operations**: New, Open, Save, Print, Export, etc.
- **Edit Tools**: Cut, Copy, Paste, Undo, Redo.
- **Insert Tools**: Insert image, chart, table, shapes, media, etc.
- **Format Tools**: Font, alignment, bullet points, text effects.
- **Slide Tools**: Slide layout, master slide, slide transitions.
- **View Tools**: Zoom, view modes, full screen.
- **Help Tools**: Help documentation, support links.

### Secondary Toolbar (Below Main Toolbar)

- **Drawing Tools**: Selection, shape drawing, line drawing, arrow, connector, etc.
- **Text Tools**: Text box, text alignment, text formatting.
- **Object Tools**: Group, ungroup, align, distribute, etc.
- **Special Characters**: Greek letters, mathematical symbols, special characters.
- **Link Tools**: Hyperlink, footnote, endnote.
- **Color Tools**: Fill color, line color, text color.
- **Other Tools**: Slide sorter, slide show controls, etc.

## Sidebar Panels

### Slides Panel (Left)

- **Slide Thumbnails**: 
  - One slide visible, labeled "1".
  - Slide thumbnail shows the title "Eradicating Heritable Disorders Through Forced Sterilization" with a large white arrow graphic.
  - Slide thumbnail has a yellow background.
- **Slide Navigation**: 
  - Scroll bar visible for navigating through slides.
  - Slide number indicator: "Slide 1 of 1".

### Properties Panel (Right)

- **Panel Title**: "Properties"
- **Character Section**:
  - Font: "Inter"
  - Font Size: "39 pt"
  - Font Style: Bold, Italic, Underline, Strikethrough, Superscript, Subscript, Text Color, Highlight Color.
- **Lists Section**:
  - List Type: Unordered List (bullets)
  - List Style: Toggle Unordered List (button with tooltip)
  - List Options: Numbered List, Bulleted List, Multilevel List.
- **Paragraph Section**:
  - Alignment: Left, Center, Right, Justify.
  - Indentation: Increase/Decrease Indent.
  - Line Spacing: Single, 1.5, Double.
  - Paragraph Spacing: Before/After.
  - Text Direction: Left-to-Right, Right-to-Left.
  - Text Wrap: None, Around, Through.
  - Text Flow: Text Flow, Text Flow with Graphics.
  - Text Orientation: Vertical, Horizontal.
  - Text Case: Uppercase, Lowercase, Title Case, Sentence Case.
  - Text Spacing: Letter Spacing, Word Spacing.
  - Text Effects: Shadow, Outline, Glow, Reflection.
